summary: BUG-150: Status - Audit history shows "0 changes / No changes yet" although Status records were created, edited and deactivated today
description:
Module: Core > Application | Screen: Status | Type: Regression | Severity: Medium
Steps to reproduce:
1. Core > Application > Status.
2. Add a Status, rename it, deactivate it (done today by the automated test: "QA Auto Status PVSLRQ").
3. Click Audit history.
Actual result: Audit history says "0 changes - No changes yet. Changes to these records will show up here."
Expected result: the created / updated / deactivated entries are listed, like on every other Core screen (e.g. State shows 122 changes).
Environment: STAGE https://erp.nexgenpilot.com (company sb, Chrome), build of 22 Nov 2026 | Automated test: TC-STATUS-14 (passed on the 21 Nov build) | Bug report ID: BUG-150
